# Release265: actual algorithmic consequences and failed bridges

Status: conditional consequence analysis of OpenAI/math snapshot adc7f1241b42e322a6451854ab7e4b4c146bf78a. The area-law and distributed-protocol proofs have not been externally certified here. We independently inspected the interfaces listed below and derived exact counterexamples and a finite-bit/subexponential consequence. No uniform polynomial-time ground-state algorithm or quantum PCP resolution was established.

## Inputs inspected and decisive changed premise

Source base: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/math/adc7f1241b42e322a6451854ab7e4b4c146bf78a/preprints/ .

- Area-law manuscript: `A-two-dimensional-area-law-from-a-global-spectral-gap-September-24-2026/build/sections/` (downloaded under `area/`). Main area theorem is `00-introduction.tex`, `thm:area`; full-system gap only, arbitrary finite induced square-lattice domains/cuts. `03-quasilocal.tex`, `prop:positive` supplies quasi-local positive contractions annihilating the ground vector, but centers their construction using unknown expectations <Omega,h_i Omega>. They are not finitely local frustration-free terms.
- PEPS manuscript: `Polynomial-PEPS-approximation-of-gapped-square-grid-ground-states-September-24-2026/build/sections/` (downloaded under `peps/`). `00-introduction.tex`, `thm:main` gives polynomial bond dimension and vector error L^-1, uniformly in H for fixed q,J,Delta. It explicitly makes no efficient acquisition/contraction assertion.
- The actual stronger mechanism is `04-compression.tex`, `thm:compression`: distributed density compression with arbitrary finite private dimensions, bounded lifetime communication incidence, and dimension-free weighted Gaussian second moments. Together with `06-geometry.tex`, `prop:protocol`, and `07-assembly.tex`, `lem:routing`, it produces a tensor network on the square grid. This is more informative than entropy alone.
- `02-information.tex`, `prop:angular`, supplies inverse-power mutual-information bounds for angularly separated sets with logarithmic minimum separation; `03-patches.tex`, `prop:patch`, supplies polynomial inside-rank *sum* with adaptive radii, explicitly not a bound on the tensor complexity of vectors on O(log^2 L) sites.
